commands:
set -eu
python3.12 - <<'PY'
import gzip,hashlib,json,pathlib,subprocess,time
root=pathlib.Path('/srv/fyp-p82'); cfg=json.loads((root/'native-original/resources.json').read_text())
out=pathlib.Path('/srv/fyp-p82-v2/supplemental-original-stopped-data');out.mkdir()
records=[]
for name in cfg['containers'][:2]:
    value=json.loads(subprocess.run(['docker','inspect',name],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout)[0]
    assert value['Config']['Labels']['research.setup']==cfg['resource_id']
    assert not value['State']['Running'],'Original server must remain stopped'
    mount=next(m for m in value['Mounts'] if m['Destination']=='/var/lib/postgresql/data')
    source=pathlib.Path(mount['Source']).resolve()
    assert source.is_relative_to(pathlib.Path('/var/lib/docker/volumes'))
    target=out/(name+'-stopped-data.tar.gz')
    subprocess.run(['tar','-czf',str(target),'-C',str(source),'.'],check=True)
    records.append({'container':name,'volume':mount['Name'],'source':str(source),'stopped':True,'archive':target.name,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'bytes':target.stat().st_size,'image':value['Config']['Image']})
(out/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps({'records':records,'scope':'Stopped physical PostgreSQL data supplementary to original logical checkpoint dumps; restoration not tested','main_started':False},indent=2))
print(json.dumps(records))
PY
systemctl show fyp-p82-qualification-v2.service fyp-p82-finish-v2.service -p ActiveState -p Result
find /srv/fyp-p82-v2/native-original/executions -name 'checkpoint.json' -exec python3.12 -c 'import json,sys;x=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]));print(x["execution_id"],x["arm"],x["status"],x.get("original_deadline"),len(x.get("polls",[])),x.get("failure"))' {} \;
